FN-F4HP5C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 20
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator William Beasley
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/21/2023
Senate Bill 20 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Board of Pharmacy to register a designated representative for each manufacturer, bottler,
packager, wholesale drug distributor, or other entity in the supply chain for pharmaceutical
products that is a current permit holder. However, the increased obligations would be offset by
new annual initial and renewal registration fees, set by the board in an amount not to exceed
$100, and new late penalty fees, also set by the board in an amount not to exceed $50. Based on
the current number of permit holders, the estimated annual receipts generated beginning January
1, 2024 is $200,000.
